crossRefs.note: This is the service of the families of the sons of Merari, according to all their service in the Tent of Meeting, under…
There are various kinds of service, and the same Lord.
There are various kinds of workings, but the same God, who works all things in all.

people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

people.name: Gershon
people.line: Firstborn son of Levi; head of the Gershonite Levites.

people.name: Ithamar
people.line: Youngest son of Aaron; served as priest.

translations.web: This is the service of the families of the sons of the Gershonites in the Tent of Meeting. Their duty shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
translations.bsb: This is the service of the Gershonite clans at the Tent of Meeting, and their duties shall be under the direction of Ithamar son of Aaron the priest.
translations.kjv: This is the service of the families of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation: and their charge shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
translations.asv: This is the service of the families of the sons of the Gershonites in the tent of meeting: and their charge shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
